title: Room change (synthetic, SFW)
premise: Mara and Sable move through their survey ship: bridge, then galley, then cargo hold, checking a faulty sensor. Tests whether the companion keeps track of where the scene is after the app moves the player between rooms.
gemini_notes: Calm shipboard errand, no danger. Mara is the captain.

R001.name: Bridge
R001.description: The bridge is a narrow curved room of blue screens and worn command chairs. A single large viewport shows the slow turn of a distant planet.

R002.name: Galley
R002.description: The galley smells of burnt toast and strong tea. Steel counters, a humming cooler, and a table bolted to the floor.

R003.name: Cargo Hold
R003.description: The cargo hold is a cold echoing cavern of strapped crates and yellow floor markings. A sensor panel blinks red near the loading ramp.
